reader: source-only reader (publisher pictures + page text as sealed in the source package); no analyzer, solver or model output was run or seen for this house
sideConvention: FRONT = the side at the BOTTOM of the ground-floor plan sheet as published; LEFT/RIGHT = the plan sheet's left/right; REAR = top of the sheet
alongShareBasis: alongShare = [from,to] as shares 0..1 of the FULL outer-wall extent of the building on that side (attached garage wing included; open porches, terraces and roof overhangs excluded), measured left to right AS SEEN FROM OUTSIDE looking at that side; read by eye from the elevation picture and cross-checked against the plan where possible; expect +/-0.04

overallWidthM.where: single overall line above the plan

overallDepthM.where: outer line right of the plan; inner chain 704 + 158 + 96

metricCertain.whatTheOverallIncludes: width 1950 = outer walls from the left wall of the living room to the right wall of the attached two-car garage (garage INCLUDED; the quarter-circle terrace on the left excluded). depth 958 = 704 (the main body and garage, rear wall to front wall) + 158 (the kitchen block that projects forward of the front wall) + 96 (the angled bay window on the front of that block): the overall depth INCLUDES the projecting kitchen block and its bay window; the walls-only depth of the main body is 704. Entrance step/porch post and terraces are not in either figure.
metricCertain.usableAreaNote: "Powierzchnia użytkowa (bez schodów)"; total_area 312.14, garage 36.84, building height 8.52 m

estimated.storeys: ground + attic (usable attic also over the garage)

mainRoof.note: the garage wing on the right carries a second, lower gable roof with its ridge in the same direction

garage.where: attached on the plan RIGHT, same front line as the house, two cars, door on the FRONT

roofFeatures.sideCertainty: front elevation matched to the plan bottom: terrace door, kitchen bay, entrance door and garage door appear in the same left-to-right order
roofFeatures.note: gabled dormer with a balcony door, standing over the projecting kitchen bay; its front wall rises in/near the facade plane and interrupts the eaves, the balcony sits on the bay roof. Could also be labelled GABLE_DORMER. Attic plan shows the door 180/230 with splayed reveals at the same place.

roofFeatures.sideCertainty: rear elevation is the mirror of the plan top: garage wing on the left, service door 100/246 and the staircase window 120/190 where the plan puts them
roofFeatures.note: narrow stone-clad wall dormer over the staircase; the stone strip runs from the ground to the gable, so the dormer wall continues the facade
one single left of the dormer, one double right of it on the main roof, one double on the garage roof
one double on the garage roof, three singles on the main roof (the one next to the dormer is partly under the watermark)
small entrance porch: one round post carries a canopy between the house and the garage (post drawn on the plan)
front-left corner of the living room is recessed under the main roof, corner carried by one post (corner arcade to the terrace); not a separate roof
two stone-clad chimneys near the ridge

uncertain: whether the front dormer wall is exactly flush with the ground-floor facade or set back by the roof of the bay (pictures are rendered elevations, not line drawings)
the side elevations show a decorative king-post truss in the plan-LEFT gable apex; it is a gable-end ornament, not a roof element
exact count of the small rear roof windows under the watermark (3 read)
